name: DFW Megacomp 2024
information:
This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2024. The registration process will prioritize new competitors for registration, and returning competitors will be accepted after. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2024. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2023 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete.

**New competitors registration will be accepted based on the following:**
* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If greater than 25% of new competitors register, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors.
* If less than 25% of new competitors register before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

**Returning competitors may still register at any point during the registration period, but their registration will be accepted based on the following:**

* The first 25% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. 
* If 25% of spots are filled by new competitors, returning competitors will then be accepted on a first come, first serve basis.
* If 25% of spots are not filled by new competitors by registration close two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors.

---

As the month of March is WCA Newcomer Month, 25% of the competitor limit will be reserved for first-time competitors or competitors who's first competition is in 2024. More information can be found on the [WCA Newcomer Month tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#36408-wca-newcomer-month).

# ***NO OUTSIDE FOOD OR DRINK IS PERMITTED IN THE VENUE.***

- Please review the [Competitor Information](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#35850-competitor-information) tab before the competition.
- Please review the other tabs for more information on the competition.

Please note that the [Schedule](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/DFWMegacomp2024#competition-schedule) is subject to change, as we may hold events slightly earlier or later than shown depending on whether the competition is running ahead of schedule or behind schedule. 

Day 1 Events: 2x2x2 Cube, 4x4x4 Cube, 5x5x5 Cube, 6x6x6 Cube, Clock, Pyraminx

Day 2 Events: 3x3x3 Cube, 7x7x7 Cube, 3x3x3 Blindfolded, 3x3x3 One-Handed, Megaminx, Square-1

This competition is supported by [CubingUSA](https://cubingusa.org/).

To learn more about cubing in the Southern USA, including other competitions, visit [Southern Cubing](https://www.southerncubing.com/).
